record.original_question: Fix k >= 2. If G has m edges and contains neither theta_{1,2,2k-1} nor theta_{1,2,2k}, must lambda(G) be at most (k - 1 + sqrt(4m - k^2 + 1)) / 2, with equality only for K_k joined with an independent set of size m/k - (k - 1)/2, for all sufficiently large m?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.11 ([30]). Let k >= 2 be a fixed integer. If G in G(m, theta1,2,2k-1) union G(m, theta1,2,2k) and m is sufficiently large, then lambda(G) <= (k-1+sqrt(4m-k^2+1))/2.
Li, Zhai and Shu [18] solved Conjecture 3.11 for k >= 3 completely.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G be a simple graph with m edges and let λ(G) denote the largest eigenvalue (spectral radius) of its adjacency matrix. For integers 1 ≤ a ≤ b ≤ c, the theta graph θ_{a,b,c} is the graph obtained by joining two distinct vertices with three internally disjoint paths of lengths a, b, and c. For a positive integer n, let K_n ∨ I_t denote the graph obtained by joining every vertex of the complete graph K_n to every vertex of an independent set I_t of size t (so K_n ∨ I_t has n+t vertices and (n choose 2) + nt edges).

Fix an integer k ≥ 2. Prove or disprove: there exists M = M(k) such that for every graph G with m ≥ M edges that contains neither θ_{1,2,2k−1} nor θ_{1,2,2k} as a subgraph,
    λ(G) ≤ (k − 1 + √(4m − k² + 1)) / 2,
and equality holds if and only if G is isomorphic to K_k ∨ I_t with t = m/k − (k − 1)/2 (so in particular k divides 2m − k(k−1)).
artifact.status_search_result: A recent survey on edge-spectral-Turán type problems states that Li, Zhai and Shu completely settled the conjecture for all k ≥ 3 for sufficiently large m. The remaining case k = 2 (forbidding θ_{1,2,3} and θ_{1,2,4}) is not reported as fully resolved in the same source, so the conjecture is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: A survey of edge-spectral-Turán type problems in spectral graph theory
status_evidence.snippet: Li, Zhai and Shu [18] solved Conjecture 3.11 for k >= 3 completely.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is fully resolved for k ≥ 3, leaving k = 2 as the remaining case.

status_evidence.title: Extensions on spectral extrema of θ_{1,2,5}-free graphs with given size
status_evidence.snippet: Extensions on spectral extrema of theta_{1,2,5}-free graphs with given size
status_evidence.claim: Active research continues on theta-graph spectral extremal problems closely related to the conjecture.
